from.description: Denormalized reference to the parent organization ({@link Supplier})

to.description: Denormalized reference to the child organization ({@link Customer})

relationship.description: The relationship identifier for this customer relationship

fromInfo.description: Denormalized type identifier of the supplier role

toInfo.description: Denormalized type identifier of the customer role

involvement.description: Placeholder field. Not used in regular computation

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

fromRole.description: The {@link Supplier} role in this customer relationship

toRole.description: The {@link Customer} role in this customer relationship

parent.description: The parent {@link Organization} in the relationship hierarchy

child.description: The child {@link Organization} in the relationship hierarchy

title: Represents a customer-supplier relationship between two organizations.
